rule: Preserve the source identity supplied by the source-tree/input stage.
Preserve the complete source-relative file path.
Preserve directory hierarchy as source context, not canonical identity.
Preserve the original filename representation exactly.
Preserve source release context without asserting canonical release identity.
Preserve the source title representation as evidence.
Preserve the complete source artist representation before source-specific interpretation.
Preserve source album-artist representation.
Preserve source album/release representation.
Preserve source composer representation before decomposition.
Standardize a supplied source recording date without replacing the original representation.
Preserve source genre vocabulary as evidence.
Preserve an embedded/source track value without assuming its semantic level.
Preserve the complete source comment before any clause interpretation.
Preserve source conductor representation when supplied.
Preserve source medium representation.
Preserve the source catalognumber representation without assuming it is a CT/TTT identifier.
Preserve available technical audio metadata.
Accept a TANGO-DJ reference as external evidence when present; do not require it for ingestion.
Preserve external reference metadata as an assertion rather than canonical truth.
